welcome.title: Welcome to Our Therapy Clinic
welcome.description: Our clinic provides professional physical therapy and wellness services to help you recover from injuries, manage chronic conditions, and improve your overall quality of life. With our expert team and personalized approach, we ensure that you receive the best care tailored to your specific needs.

doctor.title: Meet Our Doctor
doctor.name: Dr. James Wilson
doctor.bio: Dr. Wilson is a highly qualified physical therapist with extensive international experience. He has practiced in Qatar, Turkey, and Bulgaria, bringing a wealth of knowledge and diverse therapeutic approaches to his practice. His expertise spans various therapy techniques, including specialized physical therapy, therapeutic massage, and traditional methods like cupping therapy (Hijama).

testimonial1.quote: After struggling with chronic back pain for years, Dr. Wilson's treatment plan has given me amazing relief. His expertise and personalized approach made all the difference.
testimonial1.author: Maria K.

testimonial2.quote: The cupping therapy sessions have significantly improved my shoulder mobility. I'm grateful for the professional and attentive care I received.
testimonial2.author: Ahmed M.

testimonial3.quote: I was skeptical about online consultations, but Dr. Wilson provided excellent guidance for my recovery exercises. The results speak for themselves!
testimonial3.author: Stefan P.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common Questions About Our Services
faq.a1: We offer physical therapy, therapeutic massage, cupping therapy (Hijama), and online consultations.

faq.q3: How do I book an appointment?
faq.a3: You can book an appointment through our online booking system on the Book Appointment page.
faq.q4: How long is a typical therapy session?
faq.a4: A typical therapy session lasts 30-45 minutes, depending on the treatment type and individual needs.
